company.name: OLX Brazil
company.description: OLX Brazil is the country’s largest online classifieds marketplace, a joint venture between Prosus and Adevinta, facilitating peer-to-peer and B2C transactions across categories such as real estate, autos, jobs, and general goods (E5).

customers.primary_user: buyers and sellers (consumer-to-consumer and business-to-consumer) (E6, E7)
customers.buyer: sellers/listing customers (individuals and small businesses) who post listings and buy premium placement (E6, E8)
customers.payer: primarily sellers (for paid listings/premium placement); some transaction-level fees/use-cases possible (E8)
segments: category-specific buyers (autos, real estate, jobs, general goods) (E5)

business_model.value_proposition: A large, digital classifieds marketplace that improves search & discovery and matching/negotiation versus legacy classifieds by unbundling search, discovery, and direct messaging to enable efficient peer-to-peer and B2C transactions (E7, E11, E12).
business_model.revenue_model: Monetization via paid listings, premium placement/features, and transaction-stage monetization options (E8).
business_model.pricing_model: Freemium listing model with paid premium placements and paid listing features (E8).
distribution_channels: online platform (web and mobile digital channels) — digital search and browsing is core (E7)

incumbents: traditional offline classifieds and legacy media (decoupled by OLX) (E11)
direct_competitors: specialized and full-stack digital platforms competing across categories (E4)
substitutes: peer networks, social marketplaces, and offline broker/intermediary services (E7, E12)
